editorial:
Imagine taking your family on a trip to save your marriage, only to end up fighting for your lives in the middle of a wild river. You follow Gail and Tom, a couple trying to bond with their son on a rafting trip in Montana. Everything seems fine until they meet two strangers who seem a bit too eager to help. The vibe starts off as a scenic family getaway but quickly turns into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. You will feel the tension rise as you realize these strangers aren't just random travelers, but dangerous people with a dark secret.

Meryl Streep is fantastic here because she turns from a worried mom into a total survivor. The action scenes on the water are exciting and keep you on the edge of your seat. While some of the plot twists are a bit easy to guess, the pacing is fast enough that you won't mind. If you love thrillers with a lot of outdoor energy, you should definitely give this a go.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Gail uses her knowledge of the river to outsmart the villains. After a scary fight on the rapids, the bad guys are finally defeated when they are swept away by the powerful water. Gail manages to save her son and husband, proving she is the strongest person in the family. The movie wraps up with the family safe and closer than they were at the start of the trip.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and family dramas.
